deadline.value: Graduate assistantship applications for fall entry must be received by April 1. The bulletin gives no separate admission deadline, and the deadlines page lists the PhD without a date.
deadline.quote: Applications must be received by April 1st for fall applicants

gre_general.value: The GRE General is required unless the applicant holds a degree from a nationally accredited US institution.
gre_general.quote: Official scores for the Graduate Records Examination (GRE) including the AW portion | Any applicant with an undergraduate or graduate degree from a nationally accredited U.S. institution is not required to provide GRE scores

supervisor.value: Admission is decided by the Director of Graduate Studies and a faculty vote. A faculty advisor is assigned after entry.
supervisor.quote: Admission may be granted by the Director of Graduate Studies, when supported by a vote of the Graduate Faculty | Upon entry into the PhD program, the Director of Graduate Studies will serve as the initial academic advisor

funding.value: Graduate assistantships are limited and awarded competitively on the School's recommendation.
funding.quote: A limited number of graduate assistantships are available on a competitive basis

entry_route.value: Applicants need either a bachelor's with a 3.3 GPA or a master's with a 3.5 GPA.
entry_route.quote: a 3.5 overall (4.0 scale) for a completed graduate program

gre_subject.value: No subject GRE is named for this program on the pages checked.

notes: No Data Science, AI or ML PhD track is listed; the only related items are undergraduate and certificate programs, so no datasci record is saved. The bulletin says applicants need an official GRE score unless they hold a degree from a nationally accredited US institution.
